name: Adaptive Technical Assessment - QA Engineer
description: Adaptive technical questions and practical tasks to verify QA engineering and test automation competencies across manual testing, test design, web fundamentals, UI automation, API automation, non-functional testing, and quality governance.

trigger_conditions.description: When to trigger assessment questions for a subskill.
rules: When a subskill has status 'not_yet_evidenced' (confidence = 0.0) for a required role skill
When a subskill has status 'insufficient_evidence' and confidence < 0.4
When CV/LinkedIn claims a skill but GitHub has no supporting evidence (not_yet_evidenced on GitHub)
When a skill is critical for the target role (importance >= 0.80) and evidence is ambiguous
User can also voluntarily request assessment to improve their score

question_types.description: Short-answer or multiple-choice questions testing theoretical QA principles and test design.
Scenario-based troubleshooting, test strategy architecture, and root cause analysis.
Hands-on test automation coding (Playwright, Cypress, REST Assured, k6, JMeter).

adaptive_logic.description: How the system selects and adapts questions based on user evidence.
rules: Start with a conceptual question for the target subskill
If answered correctly, escalate to a scenario or practical automation task
If answered incorrectly, mark as verified_gap and recommend learning resources
Difficulty matches the target level (junior, mid, senior)

qa_fundamentals_methodology.qa_mindset_p.question: Explain the principle 'Exhaustive testing is impossible' and what criteria a QA engineer uses to decide when to stop testing.
expected_answer_keywords: prioritization based on likelihood and impact

qa_fundamentals_methodology.test_levels_.question: A team wants to replace all system integration testing with unit tests to speed up deployment. What classes of defects would escape to production with this approach?

qa_fundamentals_methodology.sdlc_stlc_mo.question: Explain the concept of 'Shift-Left Testing' in an Agile sprint. What concrete activities does a QA engineer perform during story refinement before developers write any code?

qa_fundamentals_methodology.test_plannin.question: You are assigned to create a Test Plan for a new payment gateway integration. Outline the key sections you must define, including entry, suspension, and exit criteria.

qa_fundamentals_methodology.test_design_.question: A credit scoring field accepts integers from 300 to 850 inclusive. Using 3-point Boundary Value Analysis (BVA) and Equivalence Partitioning (EP), design the exact test input values.

qa_fundamentals_methodology.test_oracles.question: Describe the 'FEW HICCUPS' heuristic framework for identifying test oracles. How does a QA engineer determine expected behavior when formal documentation is outdated or missing?

qa_fundamentals_methodology.risk_based_t.question: With only 2 days left before release and 200 regression test cases remaining, how do you perform a Risk-Based Testing (RBT) assessment to select which 30 tests to execute?

qa_fundamentals_methodology.quality_metr.question: How is Defect Removal Efficiency (DRE) calculated, and how would you use DRE together with Defect Escape Rate to diagnose whether testing gaps are happening in development, QA, or UAT?

qa_fundamentals_methodology.exploratory_.question: Explain how to structure Session-Based Test Management (SBTM). How do you author a test charter, timebox execution, and conduct debriefing sessions with stakeholders?

qa_manual_testing.test_case_authoring.question: Write a formal test case for an e-commerce checkout flow with a 20% discount coupon, specifying Title, Preconditions, Test Steps, Test Data, and Expected Results.
expected_answer_keywords: preconditions (user logged in, items in cart)

qa_manual_testing.bug_reporting_lifecycl.question: A developer marks your bug report as 'Works on My Machine'. What detailed technical information and reproduction artifacts should you provide to resolve the dispute?
expected_answer_keywords: exact environment details (OS, browser build, viewport)
console error logs and HAR file

qa_manual_testing.smoke_sanity_testing.question: What is the critical distinction between Smoke Testing and Sanity Testing regarding their timing, scope, and objectives in the deployment lifecycle?
expected_answer_keywords: sanity testing verifies bug fixes / hotfixes

qa_manual_testing.regression_testing_str.question: A team refactored the database layer for user authentication. Describe how you perform an impact analysis to select a targeted regression test suite rather than running all tests.

qa_manual_testing.exploratory_testing_ex.question: Apply James Whittaker's 'Supermodel Tour' or 'Landmark Tour' exploratory testing heuristics to test a complex multi-step financial loan application wizard.

qa_manual_testing.cross_browser_compatib.question: A CSS grid layout and date picker work flawlessly on Chrome but break on iOS Safari. What browser engine differences cause this, and how do you document the compatibility matrix?

qa_manual_testing.user_acceptance_testin.question: How do you organize and facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with non-technical business stakeholders to ensure objective sign-off before production deployment?

qa_manual_testing.localization_internati.question: When testing a software application localized for German (long strings), Arabic (RTL), and Japanese (multi-byte characters), what specific UI and functional defects do you look for?

qa_manual_testing.usability_heuristic_ev.question: Conduct a heuristic evaluation of a checkout form using Jakob Nielsen’s 10 usability heuristics. Identify 3 potential violations related to error prevention and recovery.
expected_answer_keywords: help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.html_dom_insp.question: Explain how modern web frameworks use Shadow DOM and how Shadow DOM encapsulation affects locating elements during test automation.

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.css_xpath_sel.question: Write a robust, resilient XPath and CSS selector to locate a 'Delete' button located inside a table row `<tr>` that contains the text 'Order #1042'.

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.browser_devto.question: A web button click does nothing and displays no visual error. Walk through your step-by-step debugging workflow in Chrome DevTools to uncover the issue.
expected_answer_keywords: Network tab for pending/failed XHR request

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.http_network_.question: A frontend form submission fails silently. Inspecting the Network tab reveals an HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity. How do you analyze the request payload and headers to pinpoint the validation error?
expected_answer_keywords: Response preview showing field validation errors

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.client_side_s.question: How do you test user logout security by inspecting LocalStorage, SessionStorage, and HttpOnly Cookies in the DevTools Application tab?
expected_answer_keywords: clearing JWT / auth tokens from LocalStorage

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.rendering_arc.question: How does Server-Side Rendering (SSR) with client-side hydration (Next.js/Nuxt) cause 'element is not clickable at point' test flakiness if an automation script clicks before hydration completes?
expected_answer_keywords: SSR HTML rendered before JS bundle executes
clickable DOM element but no JS listener active

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.responsive_vi.question: Explain how to automate responsive viewport testing across standard mobile (375x667), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080) resolutions to detect hamburger menu and layout break issues.

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.web_performan.question: A new release causes Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) to degrade from 1.8s to 4.2s. How do you use the DevTools Performance tab and Lighthouse to identify whether the regression is due to unoptimized hero images, render-blocking scripts, or slow API responses?

qa_web_fundamentals_for_qa.websocket_sse.question: How do you test and validate a real-time trading ticker that uses WebSockets? How do you inspect incoming/outgoing frames and simulate unexpected connection drops in DevTools?
expected_answer_keywords: WebSocket frames in Network tab (WS filter)
verifying UI recovery without page reload

qa_frontend_automation.cypress_basics.question: Write a Cypress test that visits '/login', fills in the username and password fields, clicks 'Sign In', and asserts that the URL changes to '/dashboard' with a welcome banner containing the user's name.

qa_frontend_automation.playwright_basics.question: Write a Playwright test in TypeScript that navigates to an e-commerce page, adds an item to the shopping cart, and asserts that the cart badge increments to '1' using built-in auto-waiting assertions.
expected_answer_keywords: test('add item to cart', async ({ page }) =>

qa_frontend_automation.locator_strategie.question: Explain why user-centric locators (getByRole, getByLabel, getByTestId) are preferred over CSS selectors like `.btn.btn-primary.submit-v2` or complex XPath expressions in modern test automation.
expected_answer_keywords: avoids tight coupling to implementation details

qa_frontend_automation.page_object_model.question: Refactor a monolithic 500-line test script into the Page Object Model (POM) pattern in TypeScript. Show how you separate page locators and page actions from test assertions.
expected_answer_keywords: keeping assertions inside test files, not POM

qa_frontend_automation.handling_async_wa.question: Your automation suite suffers from flakiness due to hardcoded `cy.wait(5000)` and `page.waitForTimeout()`. How do you refactor these into deterministic event-driven waits (waiting for network responses or element state)?

qa_frontend_automation.mocking_network_i.question: Write a Playwright test that intercepts a `/api/v1/user/profile` GET request using `page.route()` to return a simulated HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, and verify that the UI renders an error alert banner gracefully.
expected_answer_keywords: route.fulfill({ status: 500, body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Server Error' }) })
deterministic error testing without crashing backend

qa_frontend_automation.cross_browser_dev.question: How do you configure Playwright in `playwright.config.ts` to execute automated test suites across Chromium, Firefox, WebKit (Safari engine), and Mobile Safari device emulation?

qa_frontend_automation.visual_regression.question: You are setting up Visual Regression Testing with Playwright's `toHaveScreenshot()`. How do you handle dynamic content (timestamps, usernames), anti-aliasing variations across OS environments, and baseline updating?
expected_answer_keywords: dockerized test runner for font/rendering consistency

qa_frontend_automation.parallel_distribu.question: A 1000-test E2E suite takes 90 minutes to execute sequentially. Design a CI matrix workflow using Playwright sharding (`--shard=1/4`, `--shard=2/4`, etc.) and merge the resulting HTML reports into a single consolidated report.

qa_frontend_automation.custom_framework_.question: Design an enterprise-level test automation framework from scratch in TypeScript. Explain your directory architecture, custom fixture lifecycle, configuration management, and custom test reporter implementation.

qa_backend_api_automation.postman_newman.question: Write a Postman JavaScript test script that verifies the HTTP response code is 201 Created, the response time is below 400ms, and stores the `access_token` from the JSON response into an environment variable.

qa_backend_api_automation.http_api_test_.question: For a RESTful endpoint `PUT /api/v1/users/{id}`, design a complete set of automated API test scenarios covering positive updates, negative input validation, idempotency, and non-existent IDs.
expected_answer_keywords: 400 Bad Request on invalid payload format
404 Not Found on invalid user ID
401/403 on missing or invalid authentication token

qa_backend_api_automation.rest_assured_f.question: Write a Java test using REST Assured that sends a POST request with a JSON body to `/api/v1/orders`, sets the Authorization Bearer header, and validates using Hamcrest that `status` is 'SUCCESS' and `items.size()` equals 3.

qa_backend_api_automation.api_test_chain.question: Design an automated integration test scenario that chains 4 API requests: 1) Register user, 2) Authenticate and extract JWT, 3) Create resource with JWT, and 4) Delete resource and verify 404 on subsequent get.
expected_answer_keywords: dynamic token extraction and header injection

qa_backend_api_automation.json_xml_schem.question: How do you enforce JSON Schema validation in your API automation suite against an OpenAPI JSON Schema specification to catch breaking changes like unexpected null fields or changed data types?

qa_backend_api_automation.graphql_grpc_a.question: How does automated testing of a GraphQL API differ from a REST API? How do you test query depth limits, field alias resolution, and handle the fact that GraphQL returns HTTP 200 even when `errors` array is present?
expected_answer_keywords: GraphQL payload with query and variables
asserting errors array is null/empty on success
HTTP 200 with errors vs REST status codes
gRPC Protobuf payload testing with grpcurl

qa_backend_api_automation.mock_servers_s.question: Your backend depends on a third-party SMS verification provider that charges per API call and is unstable in staging. How do you set up WireMock to simulate successful SMS sends, timeouts, and rate limits in CI?
expected_answer_keywords: hermetic and zero-cost CI test execution

qa_backend_api_automation.contract_testi.question: Explain how to implement Consumer-Driven Contract Testing using Pact between a React frontend team and a Go microservice team. How does the Pact Broker and `can-i-deploy` tool prevent breaking changes from reaching staging?
expected_answer_keywords: Pact file generation from consumer tests
pact-broker can-i-deploy check in release pipeline

qa_backend_api_automation.database_valid.question: In an automated test for a financial transfer API, explain how you connect to the PostgreSQL database strictly as a 'test oracle' to verify account balances and ledger entries, and how you clean up test records without polluting shared databases.
expected_answer_keywords: verifying ACID state after API call
test data cleanup (transaction rollback or synthetic IDs)

qa_non_functional_testing.jmeter_load_te.question: Configure an Apache JMeter test plan with a Thread Group of 50 users, a ramp-up period of 30 seconds, a loop count of 10, an HTTP Request sampler, and a Response Assertion checking for HTTP 200.
expected_answer_keywords: Response Assertion (Field to Test: Response Code)

qa_non_functional_testing.accessibility_.question: Write a Playwright test using `@axe-core/playwright` that scans an e-commerce product page and asserts that there are zero WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility violations.

qa_non_functional_testing.k6_performance.question: Write a k6 load script in JavaScript that ramps up from 0 to 100 Virtual Users over 2 minutes, sends GET requests to `/api/v1/products`, and defines a threshold requiring 95% of requests to complete under 250ms with less than 1% error rate.

qa_non_functional_testing.performance_te.question: Compare Load Testing, Stress Testing, Spike Testing, and Soak (Endurance) Testing. For each type, define the traffic pattern and the specific failure modes it aims to uncover.
expected_answer_keywords: Load testing: expected normal traffic SLA validation
Stress testing: finding breaking point beyond capacity
Spike testing: sudden burst handling (e.g. flash sales)
Soak testing: long duration for memory leaks and resource exhaustion

qa_non_functional_testing.server_resourc.question: During a 500 VU load test, API response times suddenly jump from 150ms to 4500ms while throughput drops. How do you correlate load test timestamps with server metrics (CPU, Memory, DB Connection Pool, Garbage Collection) to find the bottleneck?
expected_answer_keywords: correlating timestamps between load generator and APM

qa_non_functional_testing.app_security_v.question: As a QA engineer, how do you verify that an API endpoint is protected against SQL Injection, Reflected XSS, and Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR) during automated quality checks?
expected_answer_keywords: testing SQL injection payloads in query parameters
verifying script tags are sanitized/escaped in output (XSS)
testing authorization on /api/orders/{id} with another user's token (IDOR)

qa_non_functional_testing.distributed_lo.question: A single load generation machine reaches 100% CPU and network socket saturation at 15,000 RPS. How do you design and orchestrate a distributed load testing cluster using k6 on Kubernetes or JMeter Master-Slave to generate 100,000 RPS?
expected_answer_keywords: load generator socket limits (ulimit, ephemeral ports)
synchronized test start and metric aggregation
avoiding load generator bottleneck skewing results

qa_non_functional_testing.advanced_acces.question: Automated tools catch only ~30% of accessibility issues. Describe your manual testing workflow with screen readers (NVDA/VoiceOver) to evaluate keyboard traps, modal dialog focus trapping, and dynamic live region announcements (`aria-live`).
expected_answer_keywords: keyboard tab navigation and focus visible
modal focus trap (tab looping inside open modal)
aria-live region announcements for dynamic updates

qa_non_functional_testing.performance_bo.question: A performance test shows p99 latency spikes on a specific microservice. Walk through your Root Cause Analysis (RCA) methodology using APM distributed traces and Flamegraphs to determine whether the delay is in database locking, downstream HTTP latency, or unoptimized thread contention.
expected_answer_keywords: database query latency vs table locks
thread dump and CPU profiling Flamegraphs

qa_test_management_reporting.testrail_ze.question: How do you organize test suites in TestRail or Zephyr to maintain a 1-to-1 traceability matrix between user stories, manual test cases, automated test results, and reported defects?
expected_answer_keywords: mapping test cases to Jira user stories
automated test result synchronization via API

qa_test_management_reporting.jira_bug_tr.question: Describe a healthy Jira bug tracking lifecycle from 'Open' to 'Closed', including Bug Triaging, 'In Development', 'Ready for QA', 'Reopened', and 'Verified'.
expected_answer_keywords: linking defect to root cause issue

qa_test_management_reporting.allure_repo.question: How do you configure Allure reporting in Playwright to automatically attach screenshots, trace recordings (`trace.zip`), and failure video files only when a test fails?

qa_test_management_reporting.ci_cd_test_.question: Write a GitHub Actions workflow job `.github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml` that checks out code, installs dependencies, installs Playwright browsers, executes tests, and uploads the HTML report artifact if tests fail.

qa_test_management_reporting.test_enviro.question: Automated test suites fail because of dirty state left by previous runs. How do you design an isolated Test Data Management strategy using database fixtures, synthetic data generators (Faker), and ephemeral test databases?
expected_answer_keywords: isolated tenant / user credentials per test

qa_test_management_reporting.flaky_test_.question: A team has 5% flaky tests that cause CI builds to fail randomly. Design a Flaky Test Quarantine policy that isolates unstable tests without blocking developer deployments while enforcing resolution SLAs.
expected_answer_keywords: running quarantined tests non-blocking in CI
root cause analysis (network vs locator vs race condition)

qa_test_management_reporting.quality_das.question: Design an Executive QA Dashboard tracking 5 key quality engineering KPIs. Define each KPI, its target threshold, and how it measures engineering velocity and product stability.
expected_answer_keywords: Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) & Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)

qa_test_management_reporting.test_strate.question: An organization has an inverted test pyramid ('ice cream cone') with 80% E2E UI tests and 20% unit tests, leading to slow, brittle 4-hour builds. How do you re-architect the test pyramid and guide teams to Shift-Left?
expected_answer_keywords: Test Pyramid restructuring (70% unit, 20% integration/API, 10% E2E UI)
pushing UI assertions down to component and API levels
reserving E2E for critical business journeys only
reducing build execution time and flakiness

qa_test_management_reporting.production_.question: How do you build a closed feedback loop between production monitoring (Sentry error rates, Datadog synthetic monitors) and the QA regression test suite to ensure that escaped production bugs are permanently prevented?
expected_answer_keywords: converting escaped production incidents to automated regression tests
synthetic monitoring in production for critical flows

scoring_rules_reference.description: Scoring rules for assessment are defined in engine.json under step_1_evidence_to_subskill_confidence.assessment_override_rules to maintain a single source of truth.
